steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Extended Answer 6 marks: A swimming pool is 25 m long, 10 m wide and 2 m deep at the deep end, sloping to 1 m at the shallow end. (a) Calculate the volume of water in the pool in m cubed. (b) Convert this to litres. (c) Water costs 0.2p per litre. Find the cost to fill the pool. The pool loses 2 cm of depth per week through evaporation.
